global: A bowl of miso ramen features a rich, amber broth with visible foam. Topped with a whole boiled egg, chashu pork, shredded green onions, and red threads, it sits in a white bowl on a wooden table under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections on its smooth, polished surface.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly raised rim, and subtle inner rim staining.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth, amber-brown, frothy surface, with noodles, green onions, and red threads floating within.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, pale cream-colored, smooth and glossy surface, slightly oval shape, subtle light reflections.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, slightly fatty texture with browned surface and visible marbling, cut into irregular shape.
